name: concurrent-bursts-reliable
body: Concurrent mutation bursts are reliable. N concurrent `apg node` / `apg edge` add|update|rm mutations (exactly what an agent issues in parallel) must never fail with a lock error: the loser either waits for the winner or the contention is removed entirely. "Lock error" covers EVERY lock the durable mutation path takes — lbug's exclusive lock on `apg/.trans/db.lbug`, the apg `specs.lock` flock, AND git's `.git/index.lock`, created and held by `git::commit_files` (src/git.rs:587-645) for the one-commit-per-mutation commit. The reference scenario is the spec-writer's parallel authoring burst — it must complete with zero lock errors, and the durable store must end up exactly as if the same mutations had run serially (no lost node, no lost edge half, no false "success"). Removal of the DB open alone does not satisfy this: the node-file read-modify-write (`edge_add`, src/node_cmd.rs:207) and the git index commit still race, so the commit path must be brought under the same serialization scope (the extended flock or the single-writer session). Acceptance: a concurrent-burst test asserting zero lock failures across all three locks — DB, `specs.lock`, and `.git/index.lock` — and a store equal to the serial equivalent.
